# Hooky Nails

> Nail salon based in Austin, Texas. Hooky Nails is a small South Austin salon with phenomenal techs, clean stations and dip, gel and nail art that isn't too thick, plus a drink while you sit.

- Phone: (737) 209-0528
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Yelp rating: 4.4 from 165 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/hooky-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/hooky-nails/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic, gel and shellac manicures with clean cuticle work and even polish.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with soak, scrub and massage.
- Dip & full sets: Dip powder (SNS), acrylic full sets and fills in any shape.
- Nail art: French tips, chrome, seasonal designs and art copied from your photo.

## About
Hooky Nails sits on Brodie Lane in South Austin. Techs like Cindy and Sue do dip (SNS), gel and shellac, full sets, French chrome and seasonal art, and pedicures. Reviewers call it a hidden gem: small, quiet, very clean, with a great color wall and a rewards program for regulars. One client drives in from North Austin because they don't fill nails too thick.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at Hooky Nails?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call (737) 209-0528 or book online.
- Q: Where is Hooky Nails?
  A: 8106 Brodie Ln, Ste 104, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about Hooky?
  A: Hooky Nails is rated 4.4 stars from 165 Yelp reviews. Clients mention phenomenal techs, a clean and quiet salon, and dip nails that aren't too thick.
